mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates through accommodative monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants price in prolonged stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals severe labor market deterioration and deepening recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to worsening economic fundamentals.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) and aggressive monetary easing (FEDFUNDS decline > 0.5pp in one month) signals coordinated policy response to severe recession, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as market anticipates stabilization.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery regime (GDP growth > 1% and UNRATE < 8%), rising housing starts (HOUST > 480) signal strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as economic momentum builds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 480 and in post-recession recovery regime, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 86) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as market prices in improving economic fundamentals.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 86, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate at zero lower bound (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) signals Fed's commitment to aggressive stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as market anticipates prolonged accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST > 480) and industrial production (INDPRO > 86) signals robust demand and supply chain recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as market prices in broad-based economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST > 480 and INDPRO > 86, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 9.0%), a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE fall > 0.2pp in one month) signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days as investors anticipate economic recovery.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0% and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
